blocks.text: INDIA / THE UNEQUAL MAP
THE COUNTRY IS MOVING FORWARD.
But not everyone gets to move at the same speed.
ONE SKYLINE. TWO REALITIES.
A booming economy can exist beside fragile housing, insecure work and missing services.
THE STORY IS NOT ABOUT EFFORT. IT IS ABOUT ACCESS.
01 / THE DISTANCE TAX

A BASIC NEED
BECOMES A JOURNEY.
When water, transport or healthcare is far away, the cost is paid in hours — often by women and children.
TIME LOST  →  INCOME LOST  →  CHOICES LOST
02 / WORK WITHOUT A SAFETY NET
HARD WORK CAN STILL BE FRAGILE.
A day without customers. A sick family member. A failed harvest. One shock can erase the month.
THE SHOCK IS PERSONAL. THE RISK IS STRUCTURAL.
03 / THE NEXT GENERATION

A CHILD'S TALENT
SHOULD NOT DEPEND ON PIN CODE.
Nutrition, safe classrooms, digital access and reliable transport decide which doors stay open.
LEARN
GROW
CHOOSE
04 / WHEN HEALTH BECOMES A FINANCIAL RISK

ILLNESS SHOULD NOT
PUSH A FAMILY BACK.
When care is distant or unaffordable, people delay treatment — and lose wages while costs rise.
ACCESSIBLE CARE  +  PREVENTION  +  PROTECTION
05 / CHANGE THE CONDITIONS
POVERTY IS NOT A PERSONAL FAILURE.
It changes when the basics stop being distant and fragile.

OPPORTUNITY
SHOULD NOT BE
A PRIVILEGE.
A fair chance begins with the systems we choose to build.
INDIA'S FUTURE MUST INCLUDE EVERYONE.
FIELD NOTES  /  INDIA
POVERTY • ACCESS • OPPORTUNITY
A HUMAN STORY, NOT A TEMPLATE.
